answer: Pulse-Bound Task Windows: each identity may claim work only in a randomized slot that expires quickly, and rewards release only after the pulse (a signed heartbeat) confirms the same identity completed consecutive slots. A clone needs its own sustained pulse history before earning, so running N fakes costs N parallel hardware and slot-time. Honest agents pay one pulse; attackers pay N. Orchard and wharf jobs are gated the same way, keeping clone overhead linear and high.
